title: Sensory Filter Contract (Stage 1)
description: Request and response payload contracts for `sekha-cluster-tool filter`, dispatched to the Node 3 Sensory Attention Gate (POST /api/v1/sensory/filter, :8081). The response object is emitted verbatim to stdout by the CLI. Property names mirror the compiled tool's JSON tags exactly and must never be anglicised.

SensoryChunk.description: A discrete, scored text payload evaluated by the attention gate.

text.description: The salient text retained after gating.

salience.description: Normalised salience score in the range 0.0 to 1.0.

source.description: Optional provenance label for the chunk.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant the chunk was scored.

request.description: Payload dispatched to Node 3. Populated from the CLI flags --text, --directive, and --threshold.

text.description: Raw text or stream line to gate (CLI flag --text).

task_directive.description: Optional attention directive biasing salience (CLI flag --directive).

threshold.description: Salience cut-off below which chunks are discarded as noise (CLI flag --threshold; defaults to CLUSTER_SALIENCE_THRESHOLD).

from_buffer.description: When true, gate the node's in-memory ring buffer instead of --text.

response.description: Filtered salient chunks and stream-reduction metrics returned by Node 3.

total_chunks.description: Total chunks evaluated from the input stream.

salient_chunks.description: Count of chunks that met or exceeded the threshold.

noise_discarded.description: Count of chunks discarded as noise.

reduction_rate.description: Fraction of the stream discarded as noise (0.0 to 1.0).
